svg.title: Four commissioning trials of the complete heater controller
svg.desc: In the capacity trial the heater runs at 100 percent and the water settles at 37.00 degrees Celsius, short of the 38 degree setpoint, as calculated. In the limits trial the command stays at 100 percent from 0.7 to 3.9 seconds and the water rises only 0.02 degrees above 39 degrees. The manual transfer keeps the command at 60 percent across the switch at 3 seconds, and the stale sensor removes heat from 5.5 seconds.
svg.text: Four commissioning trials of the complete heater controller
Control Studio validation trials · Kp 6.95, Ki 1.37, β 0.8, Tf 1 s · numbers answer the predictions
